# Ars Belli focus picks - Military advances. GENERATED by .tools/scripts/focus_picks/generate_focus_picks.js
# Edit focus_data.js and re-run the generator instead of editing this file by hand.

# Each age offers 3 branches; the pick made in the age event (ages_of_eu.1 / abm_focus_picks.1)
# sets a country variable abm_focus_<branch>, which is the only gate on these advances.
# The engine adm/dip/mil age preference (`for = X`) is no longer used: vanilla 4_choices_*.txt are emptied.
